parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO teachers_manager.book_chunks (book_id, teacher_id, chunk_index, chapter_title, page_number, content, embedding)
  SELECT $1::uuid, $2::uuid, x.chunk_index, NULLIF(x.chapter, ''), x.page, x.content, x.embedding::vector
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS x(chunk_index integer, chapter text, page integer, content text, embedding text)
  ON CONFLICT (book_id, chunk_index) DO UPDATE
    SET chapter_title = EXCLUDED.chapter_title, page_number = EXCLUDED.page_number,
        content = EXCLUDED.content, embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding
  RETURNING 1
), prog AS (
  UPDATE teachers_manager.book_sources
  SET progress = GREATEST(progress, $4::integer), updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins)::integer AS inserted;
